description: Search real-time Pinterest pins by aesthetic or product query (e.g. "ceramic mug", "japandi living room") with zero Pinterest OAuth approval. Returns HD image URLs, dimensions/aspect ratio, extracted dominant hex color + multi-swatch palette, save/repin velocity, creator profile, and outbound shop domains (Etsy, Shopify, etc.). Cost: 2 Credits / pin returned ($0.08–$0.20/1K pins; 0 Credits if empty).

cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor from a previous pins_search response.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return (1–50).

query.description: Visual aesthetic, product, or trend search query, e.g. "ceramic mug" or "mid century walnut chair".

name: pins_search

data.description: Pinterest pin search results with extracted dominant color palette summary.

count.description: Number of pins returned in this page.

dominant_palette_summary.description: Aggregated hex color swatch palette across returned pins.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of pins.

pins.description: Normalized Pinterest pin objects containing image URLs, dimensions, hex colors, save counts, creator metadata, and outbound shop links.

meta.description: Request telemetry, credit billing, and cache status metadata.

cached.description: Whether the response was served from warm cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on cache-empty or error).

took_ms.description: End-to-end server processing latency in milliseconds.

title: Search Pinterest Visual Pins & Color Palettes
